verdict.rationale: Publishing filing deadlines and late-filing penalty and interest schedules is a fair question for a government tax-filing portal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack states any filing deadline, Verspätungszuschlag, or interest schedule. The only dates cited are a 2021 requirement to apply for a tax number electronically and the July 2026 app launch, neither of which is a filing deadline or penalty figure.
